Institutional Review Board approval beyond that obtained by the originating consortia for the underlying data deposits is not required for secondary analysis of these public resources at our institution.
AI USAGE DISCLOSURE: Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI) large-language-model artificial-intelligence tools were used for coding assistance (Python analytical-script drafting and debugging), literature-audit organization (PubMed query suggestion and citation formatting), language editing, and manuscript-structure suggestions. All analyses were executed by author-run Python scripts using publicly available datasets (The Cancer Genome Atlas via cBioPortal, Gene Expression Omnibus, Therapeutic Target Database, OpenTargets, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes); no artificial-intelligence-generated data was used in any quantitative analysis. All PubMed novelty classifications, score component assignments, drug-target interpretations, and final manuscript text were reviewed and approved by the human authors, who take full responsibility for the content and the conclusions drawn.
Table 1 — Master Drug–Cancer Association Landscape Across Seven Aggressive Urologic Cancer Contexts

Master Table 1. Thirty drug–cancer associations identified by the unified public-data pipeline across seven aggressive urologic cancer contexts. Score components (G/E/P/L): G = genomic / context-anchor evidence (0–3 points; either target-level alteration frequency or disease-defining anchor alteration as enumerated in Supplementary Table S5); E = Gene Expression Omnibus transcriptomic evidence (0–3 points), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes P = pathway / gene-set enrichment (0–2 points), and L = external mechanistic-literature concordance (0 or 1 point; supports biological plausibility, distinct from the prior-proposal novelty audit); components sum to 0–9. Tier: Strong (7–9), Moderate (4–6), Exploratory (1–3). Prior-proposal status determined by independent PubMed audit using a urologic-oncology-literature-only standard (prior proposals from non-urologic cancers do not count as urologic-oncology prior). Citations provided inline. Negative biomarker: clinically-actionable predicted non-response.
